sources.snippet: Email Spam Classifier A machine learning-based classifier for identifying spam emails. Utilizes ml models and feature extraction to label emails as "Spam" or "Not Spam." This repo includes dataset, model training, and evaluation code, offering a reliable, replicable solution for spam detection.
